flight_strategy_to_pterostigmata_rule.glider_migrant: Likely reduced — gliding/soaring flight reduces need for flutter suppression; wing weight reduction advantageous
flight_strategy_to_pterostigmata_rule.strong_migrant: Likely reduced — same reasoning as glider_migrant
flight_strategy_to_pterostigmata_rule.percher: Well-developed — rapid flapping bursts require flutter suppression
flight_strategy_to_pterostigmata_rule.variable_by_species: Assess each species individually based on documented migration behavior
flight_strategy_to_pterostigmata_rule.coastal_open_water: Ambiguous — open habitat alone does not imply reduced; check migration documentation
